title: StashSyncCompletedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'stash.sync.completed'. STATE.md S8/K12 (Stash SQLite metadata sync, Lane C sync engine): emitted when a `stash-sync` job (packages/jobs, StashSyncJobPayload) finishes, successfully or not, in the SAME transaction as the paired migrations/0020_stash_sync_reports.sql report row's finalization (writeEvent(trx, ...) alongside finishStashSyncReport). `status: 'failed'` is written from apps/worker/src/stash/sync-consumer.ts's onTerminalFailure hook (mirroring apps/worker/src/probe/terminal-failure-hook.ts's precedent) once pg-boss retries are exhausted — counts then reflect whatever the checkpoint had recorded at that point, never fabricated to look complete. `counts` mirrors the report row's five S8 columns exactly (matched/updated/unmatched/stale/skipped) — H3 'no-silent-anything': every scene this run looked at lands in exactly one bucket. ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same posture as stash.sync.started.

jobId.description: Matches the paired stash.sync.started event's jobId.

libraryId.description: The library whose Stash connection this sync run was for.

status.description: 'succeeded': no unhandled error. 'partial': completed but skippedCount > 0 for a documented per-scene reason short of a full failure. 'failed': retries exhausted (onTerminalFailure) before the run reached its own end.

counts.description: Mirrors migrations/0020_stash_sync_reports.sql's five count columns for this run — a point-in-time snapshot, not a live query.

usedSnapshotFallback.description: FX4 fix wave (S2, additive optional field per the evolution policy): whether this run's Stash connection had to fall back to a snapshot copy (apps/worker/src/stash/adapter.ts's readingFrom === 'snapshot') rather than reading the source database file directly. Omitted (not false) when the run never reached a successful connectToStashLibrary call — e.g. the terminal-failure path, which has no access to the failed attempt's connection.
